integrity: Exact symbolic derivation of three lower bounds, explicit all-parameter simplex witnesses, and equality-case rigidity; 161 exact-rational witnesses and 120 independent rational Hilbert-identity checks are corroboration, not a substitute for the proof. Self-review only; independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Balanced size-n bipartite classes, n>=3, identical matching-edge lengths 1<=s<=3 and all other edge lengths one; Hilbert distortion only. No extension claimed to heterogeneous matching weights or unequal part sizes. Prior unweighted endpoint results acknowledged.
title: A flat three-regime Euclidean distortion law for matching-stretched bipartite metrics
